title: 1998 Signed Photo SCOTT BAKULA Major League: Back To The Minors “All The Best”
descriptionText:
Capture a piece of cinematic history with this 1998 signed photo featuring Scott Bakula from the comedy classic "Major League: Back To The Minors." This original 8x10 photograph, personally autographed by Bakula, is a must-have for fans and collectors alike. It's a unique keepsake that showcases the actor's charm and the film's memorable moments.

The message says “All the best!”
